newsitem.title: UK: Med products flat in thin volume.
newsitem.headline: Med products flat in thin volume.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were flat to slightly easier but business was quiet, traders said.
Gasoline was flat and quieter than normal due to the closed U.S. market which has recently attracted exports from Italy.
Unleaded premium held at around $215.00 a tonne fob Italy. Local demand was muted despite the lack fuel in France where a truckers' strike has caused shortages .s.
Naphtha was unchanged. The key Algerian export port of Skikda remains closed due to bad weather and at least four 60,000 tonne cargoes are delayed.
End user demand remains thin and arbitrage barrels are thought likely to move continue to move to the U.S., traders said.

Two high sulphur fuel tenders dominated news in a quiet market. Turkey's Tupras tendered to buy 45,000-50,000 tonnes of low density material while Portugal's EdP tendered for two cargoes plus one option in December and January.
The market was looking soft, but this should keep prices steady," said a trader pegging high sulphur at$108-109 fob Med.

Low sulphur cargoes were looking tight with nothing seen in NWE for first half Dec apart from a 20-25kt parcel and prices look steady in the low $140s cif. An Italian buyer picked up a major's cargo on Thursday on a quotes related basis.
Gas oil firmed around $3 in line with futures but physical trade was quiet. Premiums were slightly easier on indifferent demand and abundant supply.
"The market was dead. The focus was everywhere but gas oil," a trader said. Heating oil premiums were cif high quotes +$1/1.50 basis Genoa, around 50 cents weaker.
